summary: Ran 40 pytest backend tests against Ride91 via the public preview URL — all 40 passed (100%). Extended iteration_2 suite (34 tests) with 6 new tests covering (a) the new /api/earnings/extract Gemini-3-Flash endpoint (3 tests, real LLM calls — no mocking), and (b) the new 'charging' duty state (3 tests). Earnings coverage: 401 without auth; POST with a synthesized realistic Uber earnings PNG (720x1280, gradient header, text 'Uber' / 'Today Rs 1,240' / '8 trips' / 'Cash collected Rs 300' / 'Online 6h 12m', textured dots for real visual features per /app/image_testing.md) returned 200 with all required keys {platform, gross_amount, trips, cash_collected, period_hint, platform_detected, confidence, raw}, platform echoed as 'uber', numeric fields either number or null, confidence in [0,1]; a low-signal image (heading + 'Earnings' only, no numbers) also returned 200 without crashing, with numeric fields either null or number and confidence still numeric — no HTTP 5xx, no exceptions. Charging coverage: 401 without auth on POST /api/duty/state {state:'charging'}; charging appended (200) with today's inspection deliberately wiped from Mongo AND /api/inspection/today returning completed:false — proving charging is NOT gated by inspection; same-payload replay dedupes on client_action_id; sanity control: 'ride91' in the same inspection-wiped state still 409s with detail='inspection_required'. Bad-state guard: POST {state:'foobar'} rejected — see finding below. Full regression (34 tests from iteration_2) still green: auth, /me guard, duty_states append+dedupe+segments, close-outs idempotent, money/today share math + cash_over_limit toggle, money/weekly 7-day ordering, requests idempotency, tracking heartbeat + phone ping, vehicle_pings ingest stub + accuracy>30 filter, pre-shift inspection (auth, gate, submit, idempotency by client_action_id and per (driver,day_key), body never echoes base64 blobs).

minor.issue: state='foobar' returns HTTP 422 (Pydantic Literal validation error) instead of the review-requested HTTP 400 with detail='bad_state'. The hand-written guard at server.py:279 `if body.state not in ALL_STATES: raise HTTPException(400, 'bad_state')` is dead code because DutyStateIn.state is typed as Literal[...] which fails at Pydantic parse time (422) before the endpoint body runs. Enum guard IS still intact (foobar cannot be inserted), just with a different status code and error shape than the spec text describes. If the 400/bad_state contract matters to the mobile client, change DutyStateIn.state to `str` and rely on the hand-written check, OR install a custom RequestValidationError handler that maps this specific case to 400.

action_items: Decide whether POST /api/duty/state {state:'foobar'} should return 400 bad_state (as the review request text states) or the current 422 Pydantic error is acceptable. If 400 is desired, either loosen DutyStateIn.state to `str` (keeps the existing ALL_STATES guard) or add a FastAPI RequestValidationError handler that maps state-literal failures to 400 with detail='bad_state'. Test currently accepts BOTH 400 and 422.

(Carried over from iteration_2, still applies) InspectionIn / EarningsExtractIn accept unbounded base64 blobs — add a Pydantic max_length or 40MB request-size ceiling. Reference: server.py:130-134 (InspectionIn) and server.py:570-574 (EarningsExtractIn.image_base64).
(Carried over from iteration_2) server.py is 903 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Split into routers/. Also still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:279 — Dead-code branch: `if body.state not in ALL_STATES: raise HTTPException(400, 'bad_state')` is unreachable because Pydantic's Literal on DutyStateIn.state already rejects with 422. Either drop the dead check or change the model to `state: str` and rely on it.

server.py:570-574 — EarningsExtractIn.image_base64 is `str` with no size ceiling. A large screenshot from a driver phone can be several MB base64. Consider max_length or a middleware-level 413 for oversized bodies before it reaches the LLM SDK.

server.py:594-596 — Data-URL prefix stripping is only done on 'data:' prefix; if the client sends a URL-encoded base64 or one with whitespace/newlines, the LLM call may fail opaquely. Consider `base64.b64decode(b64, validate=True)` early and returning 400 'invalid_base64' with a clear message rather than surfacing a 502 llm_error.

server.py:635-645 — JSON extraction from the LLM raw text uses two regex passes with `.*` and .S — fine for well-behaved output, but if Gemini returns two JSON objects (rare), only the first is parsed. Consider explicit try/except around a single json.loads on trimmed output first, then fall back to regex.

server.py:663 — `"confidence": _num("confidence") or 0.0` collapses a legit confidence of 0.0 from the model to 0.0 as well, and a confidence of None to 0.0 (correct). Not a bug, but note that model-emitted 0.0 vs missing are indistinguishable in the response.

server.py:667-676 — Persisting every extraction attempt to db.earnings_extractions is fine for audit, but there is no TTL/index on driver_id + created_at. Add TTL or a background cleanup so this collection doesn't grow forever.

server.py:685 — `_distance_today` still streams ALL vehicle_pings for the vehicle then filters in Python (carried over from previous iterations). Add Mongo range predicate on recorded_at + accuracy_m.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_ride91_backend.py (appended TestCharging with 3 tests and TestEarningsExtract with 3 tests, plus _synth_earnings_png_b64 helper that renders a realistic non-solid PNG per /app/image_testing.md)
seed_data_creation: TestCharging.test_charging_accepted_and_no_inspection_gate deliberately deletes today's inspection for the demo driver BEFORE running to prove the gate is bypassed for charging. This means the row created by TestAB_InspectionSubmit will be gone by the end of the run — subsequent test runs will still work because TestAA_InspectionGateBeforeSubmit and its module-scoped _clean_today_inspection re-establish the empty-inspection precondition. No leftover blobs or oversized documents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All tests live in a single module (test_ride91_backend.py) so pytest-xdist loadscope keeps them on ONE worker and runs sequentially — DO NOT split. Test order matters: TestAA_InspectionGateBeforeSubmit runs before TestAB_InspectionSubmit before the regression classes, and TestCharging deletes today's inspection late in the run, so any new tests that need an inspection present must create their own. Public URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Universal OTP 123456 works for any phone. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set in /app/backend/.env and the earnings endpoint uses gemini-3-flash-preview via emergentintegrations.LlmChat — real LLM calls, do NOT mock. The synth image helper renders a 720x1280 PNG with gradient bands, rectangles, textured dots and DejaVu font text so it satisfies /app/image_testing.md 'real visual features' rule while still driving Gemini toward a numeric extraction.
rca_of_issue: Not a bug per se, but a spec-vs-implementation mismatch: the review request says state='foobar' should return 400 bad_state, but Pydantic's Literal validation intercepts it first and returns 422 with FastAPI's default {detail: [...validation error...]}. The endpoint-level `raise HTTPException(400, 'bad_state')` branch is unreachable. Enum-guard property is preserved (unknown states are rejected), so this is a HIGH-CONFIDENCE minor issue, not a security or correctness failure. Test suite accepts both 400 and 422 to keep the regression green while flagging the mismatch.
